help.RELATES: The issues are related. There is no direction.
help.BLOCKS: The target issue can start only after this one is done.
help.PRECEDES: The target issue comes after this one.
help.DUPLICATES: This issue is the same work as the target issue.

list.emptyBody: Issues you create appear here. Track them by type, status, assignee and dates.
list.emptyBodyReader: This project has no issues yet.

create.title: New issue
create.description: Choose a type and a title to create an issue. If you leave the manager empty, you become the manager.

form.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Password reset email never arrives
form.managerHelp: Leave empty to become the manager yourself.
form.managerLocked: Changing the manager needs the 'Assign issue managers' permission.
form.peopleUnavailable: You cannot see the workspace member list, so only the current value can be chosen.
form.parentHelp: Leave empty for a top-level issue.
form.statusDatesHelp: Moving to Done fills Completed on with today, and moving to Closed fills Closed on, when they are empty. Moving back to New or In progress clears both.
form.startAfterPlanned: The start date is after the planned end.
form.startAfterDue: The start date is after the due date.
form.completedAfterClosed: Completed on is after Closed on.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Write what needs to be done, why, and when it is finished. You can use ## headings, lists, tables and code blocks.

edit.heading: Edit issue
edit.notesHelp: If you write it, it is kept as a comment with this change in the history.
edit.conflictBody: Someone changed this issue after you opened it. Reload to see the current content, then edit again. Reloading discards your changes here.

view.notFoundBody: The number is wrong or the issue was deleted.
view.archivedBanner: This issue belongs to an archived project. It cannot be changed until the project is restored.
view.conflict: Someone else changed it first. The current content has been reloaded.
view.diagramInvalid: The diagram syntax is not valid.
view.diagramStale: The current text cannot be drawn, so the last drawn diagram is shown.

comment.label: Comment (Markdown)
comment.placeholder: Write a comment. Markdown is supported.

remove.title: Delete issue
remove.body: Issue to delete: #{{number}} {{title}}. Once deleted, this issue and its links can no longer be seen. This cannot be undone.
remove.hasChildren: This issue has child issues ({{count}}), so it cannot be deleted. Move or delete the child issues first.
remove.confirmLabel: To confirm, type the issue number {{number}}
